items: This guide helps you find the responsible public institution or related organization by topic and continue to that organization's own official announcement.
It is not an official government website.
It is not a breaking-news service, news site, or fact-checking service.
It is not a rating service for organizations or sources, or an AI summary or decision service.
Listing does not guarantee an organization's overall reliability or recommend all of its activities.
This site does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or currency of destination information. Check the organization's own official announcements for current information.
For evacuation and safety decisions during a disaster, follow the latest information from the relevant authorities. This site does not determine current disaster conditions.
In the future production version, destinations will be external sites and their policies will apply after you leave this site.
Display order does not represent importance, reliability, accuracy, or recommendation. Destination groups and usage situations do not represent importance or urgency.

privacy.input_heading: 2. Input and registration on this site
input_items: The site does not provide an input form.
The site does not provide sign-in or account registration.
The site does not ask you to enter or submit a name, email address, street address, or similar information.
unused_items: The site does not use AI, external APIs, web search, automated collection, RSS, crawling, or scraping.
The site does not use advertising, affiliate marketing, or analytics tools.
The site does not use cookies or localStorage.
session_items: The site stores only standard or large to keep your selected text size while you move between pages in the same tab.
It does not store organization names, browsing history, URLs, search terms, or personal information.
It does not send the saved value to a server or external service, and does not retain it after the tab is closed.
If sessionStorage is unavailable, the site displays the standard text size.
external_items: The future production version will lead to external sites of public institutions, related organizations, and the contact destination.
The destination's privacy policy and other terms apply after leaving this site. This site does not control information collected or stored by an external site.
External URLs are not links in this fictional preview.
contact_items: This site does not provide a contact form and instead points to an external contact page.
In this preview, the fictional contact URL is shown as text and is not a link.
logs_items: Hosting, CDN, and the production environment have not been decided, so this policy does not claim that no access logs will be recorded.

Before production launch, the operator will review IP addresses, user agents, access times, CDN, WAF and hosting logs, purposes of use, retention periods, and who can access the logs, and will reflect the results in the production policy.
revision_items: Changes to this policy will be announced on this page.
